summary: Five churches in one family; one shared Mass schedule box on page 1 gives weekend, weekday and Confession times, and it is identical in all three bulletins read. Corpus Christi has a First Saturday 8:45 AM Mass and a dated Dozynki Harvest Mass on Oct 11. St. Adalbert has no regular schedule in these bulletins. No open questions.
